summary: Requirement-grain telemetry field strand narrates nothing for an unfilled (satisfier-less) requirement — dead for context-arrives, its one live consumer.

edit.description: requirement_detail (~1468-1566): the `satisfiers.is_empty()` early return at 1507-1510 exits before the telemetry field-strand append at 1551-1563, so a Telemetry-verified requirement with zero satisfiers (context-arrives, live) prints only "No member satisfies it." and never reaches the strand. Move the verifier check + telemetry::requirement_field append above that early return so an unfilled requirement still narrates its telemetry evidence (or absence). Build a `member_index` via the existing `build_member_index(by_kind)` helper (already called this way at 281/396/721/1006) and thread it into the widened requirement_field call below.

requirement_field (126-236): line 152 (`if !satisfier_set.contains(&record.identity) { continue; }`) counts only records whose identity is in `satisfier_ids` — for a satisfier-less requirement that set is empty, so every record is discarded and every event tallies zero regardless of what the log actually holds. Add a `member_index: &BTreeMap<&str, Vec<(&str, &Features)>>` parameter (the same corpus `field` (27-104) joins denominators against); when `satisfier_ids` is empty, join records and report zero-hit entries over `member_index`'s declared members instead of the empty satisfier set — matching `field`'s "declared wiring against the empty log, evidence never verdict" discipline (pipeline.md, Telemetry) rather than silently reporting nothing. Update the doc comment (118-125) to state the satisfier-less fallback.

Every existing telemetry-requirement test (920-1100+) gives the requirement satisfiers via `feature(..., &["telemetry-req"])` — the satisfier-less cell is untested and is exactly the one that's broken live. Add: (1) a Telemetry-verified requirement with zero satisfiers and an empty tap log — asserts the field strand still appears (not silence) and states the requirement is unfilled/absence-narrated; (2) the same shape with real tap records naming declared (non-satisfying) members — asserts per-event counts narrate against the declared member corpus rather than reporting zero-of-zero. Mirror the existing `an_absent_log_with_declared_telemetry_narrates_the_absence_against_the_declared_wiring` (521-538) pattern used for member-grain `field`.

tests.asserts: a Telemetry-verified requirement with zero satisfiers still narrates a field strand (evidence or stated absence), never silence
a satisfier-less requirement's field strand joins counts/zero-hits against the lock-declared member corpus, not the empty satisfier set

acceptance: `temper explain context-arrives` (or any satisfier-less Telemetry-verified requirement) prints a field strand narrating either the declared corpus's zero records or real per-event counts — never just "No member satisfies it." with no telemetry line, matching the absence-narration discipline member-grain `field` already implements.
notes: Routed from inbox (observed 18cf4d96; re-verified live at HEAD 3e282a1f, no src/tests/sdk commits landed between so the gap is unchanged): confirmed on disk the early return (read.rs:1507-1510) precedes the strand append (:1551), confirmed telemetry.rs:152's satisfier-only join, reproduced live via `temper explain context-arrives` printing only "No member satisfies it." 6246cb22 shipped the wiring but every fixture gave satisfiers, so this cell shipped untested. scoped at 3e282a1f.
